name: Alison.AI
description:
Alison.ai is a creative intelligence platform for performance marketers. This connector gives Claude direct access to your creative performance data across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels, analyzed down to the element level: hooks, colors, messaging, pacing, and more.
Ask questions like "which hook styles are driving CTR this month," "which of my ads are fatiguing," or "score this new creative before I launch it." Claude answers from your actual account data, powered by the same engine behind Alison's Creative Genome, Preflight Plus, and Creative Fatigue Detector.
Requires an Alison.ai account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alison.AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alison.AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://evo.alison.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alison.AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alison.AI lists 14 MCP tools, including describe_integrations, describe_marketing_entity, discover_competition_filters, discover_filters, get_asset_labels, get_creative, list_competition_metrics, list_features, list_integrations, list_kpis, run_competition_report, and run_recipe.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alison.AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alison.AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Alison.AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alison.AI is developed by Alison.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
